title: On the n-perfectness under split nilpotent extensions
summary: Let $π:S\twoheadrightarrow R$ be a split ring epimorphism with nilpotent kernel $J$, and let $R\hookrightarrow S$ be a fixed ring-theoretic section. We prove a change-of-rings formula which is considerably stronger than an equality of global invariants: if $X$ is a left $S$-module satisfying $\Tor_i^S(R,X)=0$ for every $i>0$, then \[ \pd_S X=\pd_R(R\otimes_S X) \] in $\mathbb N\cup\{0,\infty\}$.
